correctness.rationale: Exact Hermitian lifting: the 9x9 determinant is -5832(s-1)^6(s+1)^2(2s+1)^2(s²+2); the eight-row kernel matrix has determinant -(s²+s+1)^4(2s^4+2s^3+5s²+6s+3), strictly negative by an explicit sum-of-squares. Unitary Gabor covariance covers all erasures, ranks 3/7/7 cover exceptions, and odd determinant in a 2D Hermitian kernel excludes seven measurements. verify.py ran and passed.
